contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return initial multiplied by retention raised to periods. Retention is a fractional multiplier, not a percentage loss. Zero periods leaves initial unchanged, including when retention is zero.
contract.domain: Initial is between 0 and 1000; retention is between 0 and 1; periods is an integer from 0 through 20.
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
